notes.title: Cyber Blades is now free demo
notes.content:
Cyber Blades is now switching to a free demo.

As previously mentioned, we decided that it is important to receive more feedback on the game, and since the direction of development has not been confirmed, we are converting the current game into a free demo.

Customers who purchased it can also get a refund by requesting one regardless of normal restrictions.

Thank you for your support for the game, and we look forward to seeing you in the future.

notes.title: Pricing policy to be changed - Converting current game to a free demo
notes.content:
Hello, I am a Cyber Blades developer.

After monitoring the community's reaction after launch, we found that the game in its current state is still far from satisfying buyers overall.

It's never been our goal to sell unsatisfactory games, so it's time to take the time to set the overall direction for the project and set goals for the full version.

We plan to convert the current state game to a free demo version. We are discussing with Valve to make this transition smoothly.

- For those who have purchased the product, we are considering a refund.
- If you are considering purchasing the product, please delay the purchase for a while. You will get a free demo version of the game's current state.

I appreciate your interest in the game, and we will come back to you with a better game.
